mechanism: Praziquantel is metabolized by CYP450 enzymes, and beta-lactam antibiotics may alter gut flora affecting enterohepatic circulation and metabolism of praziquantel, potentially reducing its efficacy.
action: Monitor clinical response to praziquantel therapy; consider spacing doses if possible and ensure adequate praziquantel dosing; no dose adjustment typically required but be aware of potential reduced antiparasitic efficacy.
